records.body:
You are acting as Devoted Landscaping’s senior social-media strategist, local-service marketer and creative director.

Create content for: Instagram Reel · Short-form video or Images.

Business: Devoted Landscaping LLC
Service area: Hays County, Comal County, Wimberley, Dripping Springs, San Marcos and New Braunfels, Texas.

Objective: Showcase a Company, milestone, and how it parallels to our overall business
Audience: Local homeowners and property managers
Project/service: NOT PROVIDED
Location: NOT PROVIDED
Available assets: Photos of the old trucks, as well as photos of the new truck and photos of the Team in front of the new truck
Raw idea: Trading in three old trucks for a brand new truck and using that as an encapsulation of how a business transforms just like the landscape transforms and sometimes renewal and refreshment is the best thing that you can possibly do even if it costs a little bit upfront
Verified facts: Three trucks: two trucks from 2005 and one truck from 2008; traded in for a brand new 2026 Dodge ram 2500. Yes, it might have provided an initial expense and a bit of sticker shock, but when it’s all set and done, it’s one of the things that you have to do as a business to make sure that you are planning ahead and doing what’s best for the future of your operation, your team, and your business as a whole.
Desired tone: Professional, approachable, clever
Call to action: Invite viewers to contact Devoted Landscaping
Length: Concise
Hashtag approach: Relevant local and service tags; avoid spammy tags

Deliverables:
Caption; three hooks; on-screen text; Reel sequence; hashtag set

Requirements:
- Preserve every verified fact.
- Do not invent customer details, measurements, project results, dates or testimonials.
- Treat every NOT PROVIDED field as unknown and say what missing information would materially improve the result.
- Use Devoted’s professional but approachable local brand voice.
- Avoid generic landscaping clichés.
- Lead with a strong hook.
- Make the transformation, human story or practical value clear.
- Use location-specific language only when the location is confirmed.
- Keep hashtags relevant and avoid obviously spammy tags.
- Provide the strongest recommended option first.

records.title: Knickerbocker - La Cima - Flower Bed and Yard Xeriscape Project
records.body:
Property - Project Overview and Renderings
• The front flower bed is going to be renovated to where the entire flower bed is completely level.
• It will be with white flagstone.
• All the plants will be demoed, and we’re going to go for a xeriscape look just like at Eagle Mountain, 
• EXCEPT - it’s going to be with slate as Black Star rock to complement the color scheme of the house.
• The two tree rings will be replaced with white chopped stone to create a border
• And to stay in the same flow of rock as the bed connected to the house
